activity_context.topic_title: Symmetry Properties of the Standard Normal Distribution

examples.knowledge_point: Computing a Probability on an Unbounded Interval Using the Complement
examples.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/4d6524ff1e32b2c2b4aaf7481dbf63a96f847cd91ce66aeeb58690f37bbe50e5.png)

For a random variable $Z \sim N(0,1),$ we have the following symmetry property for $a > 0{:}$

$$
P(Z \gt a) = P(Z \lt -a) = \Phi(-a)
$$

We're given that $Z\sim N(0,1),$ and we wish to compute $P( Z \lt -1.54).$ The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/52d4c1add91819ff1f9dddf609b5753506c26e6cd6ee7f3cb14150ccb9b60971.png)

By symmetry, this equals the area corresponding to the probability $P(Z \gt 1.54).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/7fef056bb5564986a009198685a2951de87ccb8e09c932c6902bfafdcdf0656f.png)

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Z<-1.54) & =P(Z>1.54) \\  & =1-P(Z<1.54) \\  & =1-Φ(1.54) \\  & =1-0.9382 \\  & =0.0618.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/37674375730f32a70d7909a7ab01f3f9c836cf9c72d16447d499af20427f022c.png)

For a random variable $Z∼N(0,1)$ we have the following symmetry property for $a>0:$

$$
P(Z>-a)=P(Z<a)=Φ(a)
$$

We're given that $Z∼N(0,1),$ and we wish to compute $P(Z>-0.97).$ The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/a8b07524ca3a1ac1750f86e9a5088a07150d7d1b038158e74d924b8811a405a0.png)

By symmetry, this equals the area corresponding to the probability $P(Z<0.97).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069722/assets/ef497f11f5ec451215e923157b6675d16c175dc23ec7d6576bf0a018e3ef594c.png)

Therefore,

$$
P(Z>-0.97)=P(Z<0.97)=Φ(0.97)=0.8340.
$$
